coins.name: Coins
coins.desc: Stamped copper pieces. Every trader in the Hollowmarch takes them.

bones.name: Bones
bones.desc: Picked clean. Some in Havenbrook still bury what they find.

ember_blade.name: Ember Blade
ember_blade.desc: Warm to the touch, even in the cold under the mountain. One blow in four, what it cuts is left burning.

apprentice_staff.name: Apprentice Staff
apprentice_staff.desc: The runes have mostly worn off. Enough of them are left.

leather_body.name: Leather Jerkin
leather_body.desc: Boar hide, boiled and cut. Quiet, and warmer than it looks.

leather_legs.name: Leather Chaps
leather_legs.desc: Stitched from the same hide as the jerkin.

hide_boots.name: Hide Boots
hide_boots.desc: Boar hide sewn with the grain and greased against the wet. Light on the foot: you walk a twentieth quicker in them.

bone_amulet.name: Bone Amulet
bone_amulet.desc: Carved from something that walked out of the Mire once.

raw_meat.name: Raw Meat
raw_meat.desc: Needs a fire before it needs a plate.

raw_boar.name: Raw Boar Haunch
raw_boar.desc: A heavy cut. Worth the trouble of carrying it back.

cooked_boar.name: Roast Boar
cooked_boar.desc: Restores 16 hitpoints. Worth saving for a hard fight.

herbal_tonic.name: Herbal Tonic
herbal_tonic.desc: Bitter, green, and it works. Restores 22 hitpoints.

logs.name: Logs
logs.desc: Split pine. The guild always wants more of it.

oak_logs.name: Oakwood Logs
oak_logs.desc: Dense and slow to season. Bowyers pay well for it.

birch_logs.name: Birchwood Logs
birch_logs.desc: White bark that peels like paper, pale wood under it. Light, straight and strong: what a good shaft is made of.

swamp_logs.name: Swampwood Logs
swamp_logs.desc: Cut from a drowned tree in the Bayou. Black with the water it grew in, and it will not rot: nothing in it is left to.

ashen_logs.name: Ashen Wood Logs
ashen_logs.desc: Burnt to the heart on the Ashen Path and still warm in the middle. It takes a flame and does not catch.

hide.name: Raw Hide
hide.desc: Still needs curing, but it is worth carrying home.

thread.name: Waxed Thread
thread.desc: A spool of it. Sold by the yard in Havenbrook.

copper_ore.name: Copper Ore
copper_ore.desc: Green-streaked rock. Heavier than it has any right to be.

iron_ore.name: Iron Ore
iron_ore.desc: Dull red and dense. The forge will know what to do with it.

ruby.name: Uncut Ruby
ruby.desc: Deep red, badly chipped, and still worth a month of work.

elder_letter.name: Maren's Letter
elder_letter.desc: Folded twice, sealed with grey wax. Addressed to the guild.

rusted_key.name: Rusted Key
rusted_key.desc: Long teeth, orange with age. It opens something in Emberfell.

mossvale_house_key.name: Mossvale House Key
mossvale_house_key.desc: Wrapped in oilcloth and left under a stone. It opens the empty house at the bottom of Mossvale, which is yours now.

warchief_totem.name: Warchief's Totem
warchief_totem.desc: Bound bone and red cord. Taken from the thing that carried it.

ember_shard.name: Ember Shard
ember_shard.desc: A splinter of something still burning, a long way underground.

barrow_seal.name: Barrow Seal
barrow_seal.desc: A clay disc pressed with a name nobody in town will read aloud.

torn_page.name: Torn Page
torn_page.desc: Half a survey of the Sunken Road, in a careful, frightened hand.

training_bow.name: Training Bow
training_bow.desc: Guild issue, half the draw weight, and it never misses the butts.

novice_staff.name: Novice Staff
novice_staff.desc: A stick with one working rune on it. That is one more than none.

bedroll.name: Bedroll
bedroll.desc: Canvas, a blanket and a groundsheet. Use it under open sky to pitch camp, and sleep there after dusk.

dream_shard.name: Dream Shard
dream_shard.desc: A sliver of a dream that came back with you. It is warm, and it hums when nobody is listening.

dreamcatcher.name: Dreamcatcher
dreamcatcher.desc: Thread and shards on a willow hoop. What it catches, it keeps.

fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing_rod.desc: Willow, waxed line and a bent hook. Carry it to fish; Fishing decides how quickly they bite.

raw_minnow.name: Raw Minnow
raw_minnow.desc: A thumb-long silver fish. Everyone starts somewhere.

raw_trout.name: Raw Trout
raw_trout.desc: Speckled and fighting. It came out of cold water.

raw_pike.name: Raw Pike
raw_pike.desc: Long, green and all teeth. Mind your fingers.

raw_salmon.name: Raw Salmon
raw_salmon.desc: Heavy, bright and running upstream when you caught it.

raw_eel.name: Raw Eel
raw_eel.desc: It is still trying to leave. Cook it before it does.

raw_frostfin.name: Raw Frostfin
raw_frostfin.desc: Pulled up through a hole in the Glass Mere, as pale as the ice and nearly as cold. It keeps a week without salt.

raw_cindergill.name: Raw Cindergill
raw_cindergill.desc: It lives in the lava moat under the Brimstone Palace, which should not be possible, and its gills are still glowing. Take it off the hook with tongs.

raw_scaldfin.name: Raw Scaldfin
raw_scaldfin.desc: It lives in the hot brine pools of the Terraces, where nothing should, and comes out of the water already half cooked. Finish the job.

raw_deepgleam.name: Raw Deepgleam
raw_deepgleam.desc: From the bottom of a sea nobody has filled. It gives off a light of its own, and goes on giving it off on the plate.

marigold.name: Marigold
marigold.desc: A bright orange head from the open fields. The start of half the remedies in the Hollowmarch.

brookmint.name: Brookmint
brookmint.desc: Cold, sharp-smelling leaves that only grow with their feet wet.

nettle.name: Stinging Nettle
nettle.desc: It stings going in and it stings going down, and it puts iron in the arm.

bogbean.name: Bogbean
bogbean.desc: Three fat leaves on a stalk out of the black water. Bitter enough to wake the dead.

mountain_sage.name: Mountain Sage
mountain_sage.desc: Grey-green and tough as the rock it clings to.

glowcap.name: Glowcap
glowcap.desc: A pale mushroom that gives off a faint light in the shade of old trees.

emberbloom.name: Emberbloom
emberbloom.desc: A red flower that grows only where the ground is scorched. It is warm to hold.

moonpetal.name: Moonpetal
moonpetal.desc: A silver-blue flower that exists only in dreams, and somehow comes back with you.

starlily.name: Starlily
starlily.desc: Its petals hold a little light of their own. The rarest thing that grows in the Reverie.

rimebloom.name: Rimebloom
rimebloom.desc: A blue flower that opens under the snow and never above it. Frost forms on the petals even in a warm hand.

cinderwort.name: Cinderwort
cinderwort.desc: It grows at the lava's edge in the Kiln, and its leaves smoulder without ever burning down.

tidecress.name: Tidecress
tidecress.desc: Cress from the sand of the Deeps, still wet whatever is done to it. It tastes of a sea that was never there.

aetherbell.name: Aetherbell
aetherbell.desc: A pale bell of a flower from the islands of the Firmament. It rings, very faintly, when the wind goes through it, and there is always wind.

swallowtail.name: Swallowtail Butterfly
swallowtail.desc: Yellow barred with black, and a tail to each hind wing. It drifts between the trees of the Whisperwood and the Brackenwood, and a slow hand can close round one.

marsh_dragonfly.name: Marsh Dragonfly
marsh_dragonfly.desc: Blue-green and as quick as a thrown knife. It hunts the Bayou's open water and rests on the reeds at the edge of it.

firebug.name: Firebug
firebug.desc: A beetle with an ember for a tail, warm through the jar. It lives where the lava runs on the Ashen Path.

rime_beetle.name: Rime Beetle
rime_beetle.desc: A hard little beetle glazed with a frost that never melts. It picks its way over the ice of the high cold.

vial.name: Glass Vial
vial.desc: An empty vial with a cork. Every brew needs one.

healing_draught.name: Healing Draught
healing_draught.desc: Marigold steeped until the water turns gold. Restores 20 hitpoints.
healing_draught.recipe_from: Oona the herbalist in Mossvale teaches it to anyone who asks.

mana_tonic.name: Mana Tonic
mana_tonic.desc: Clear and freezing cold. Restores 40 mana.
mana_tonic.recipe_from: Oona sells the recipe in Mossvale.

scroll_mana_tonic.name: Recipe: Mana Tonic
scroll_mana_tonic.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Mana Tonic.

nettle_brew.name: Nettle Brew
nettle_brew.desc: Dark green, and it stings. Boosts Strength by 3 and a tenth.
nettle_brew.recipe_from: Tobin's General Store in Havenbrook sells the recipe.

scroll_nettle_brew.name: Recipe: Nettle Brew
scroll_nettle_brew.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Nettle Brew.

fen_bitters.name: Fen Bitters
fen_bitters.desc: Foul, and worth it. Restores all stamina and 12 hitpoints.
fen_bitters.recipe_from: Hob the Pedlar sells the recipe at the woodcutter's camp.

scroll_fen_bitters.name: Recipe: Fen Bitters
scroll_fen_bitters.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Fen Bitters.

stoneskin_draught.name: Stoneskin Draught
stoneskin_draught.desc: Grey and gritty. Boosts Defence by 3 and an eighth.
stoneskin_draught.recipe_from: Garrow the smith sells the recipe in Mossvale.

scroll_stoneskin_draught.name: Recipe: Stoneskin Draught
scroll_stoneskin_draught.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Stoneskin Draught.

hunters_focus.name: Hunter's Focus
hunters_focus.desc: It glows faintly in the vial. Boosts Ranged by 4 and an eighth.
hunters_focus.recipe_from: Hunter Ivo sells the recipe in Havenbrook.

scroll_hunters_focus.name: Recipe: Hunter's Focus
scroll_hunters_focus.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Hunter's Focus.

emberfire_elixir.name: Emberfire Elixir
emberfire_elixir.desc: Hot enough to feel through the glass. Boosts Attack and Strength by 4 and an eighth.
emberfire_elixir.recipe_from: The Collector in the Reverie sells the recipe.

scroll_emberfire_elixir.name: Recipe: Emberfire Elixir
scroll_emberfire_elixir.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Emberfire Elixir.

moonlit_draught.name: Moonlit Draught
moonlit_draught.desc: Silver, and it moves in the vial when nothing touches it. Restores 80 mana and boosts Magic by 5 and an eighth.
moonlit_draught.recipe_from: The Night Pedlar in the Reverie sells the recipe.

scroll_moonlit_draught.name: Recipe: Moonlit Draught
scroll_moonlit_draught.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Moonlit Draught.

starlily_panacea.name: Starlily Panacea
starlily_panacea.desc: A little starlight in a bottle. Restores 40 hitpoints, 100 mana and all stamina, and boosts every combat level a little.
starlily_panacea.recipe_from: The Collector in the Reverie opens that case only for someone who has calmed Hesper's pond.

scroll_starlily_panacea.name: Recipe: Starlily Panacea
scroll_starlily_panacea.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Starlily Panacea.

swallowtail_draught.name: Swallowtail Draught
swallowtail_draught.desc: As bright as the wing it was made from, and it leaves the eye as quick. Boosts Attack by 3 and a twelfth.
swallowtail_draught.recipe_from: Hob sells the recipe from his pack in the Whisperwood.

scroll_swallowtail_draught.name: Recipe: Swallowtail Draught
scroll_swallowtail_draught.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Swallowtail Draught.

honeyed_draught.name: Honeyed Draught
honeyed_draught.desc: Sweet enough to get down on the run. Restores 30 hitpoints and all stamina.
honeyed_draught.recipe_from: Isolde sells the recipe at Hidewater in the Westwold.

scroll_honeyed_draught.name: Recipe: Honeyed Draught
scroll_honeyed_draught.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Honeyed Draught.

skimmer_tonic.name: Skimmer Tonic
skimmer_tonic.desc: Blue-green and never quite still in the glass. Restores 60 mana and boosts Magic by 3 and a tenth.
skimmer_tonic.recipe_from: Oona sells the recipe in Mossvale.

scroll_skimmer_tonic.name: Recipe: Skimmer Tonic
scroll_skimmer_tonic.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Skimmer Tonic.

cinderbug_ward.name: Cinderbug Ward
cinderbug_ward.desc: Warm through the glass, and it keeps the warmth in rather than letting more in. For five minutes nothing can set you burning, and burning ground bites half as hard.
cinderbug_ward.recipe_from: Garrow sells the recipe at his smithy in Mossvale.

scroll_cinderbug_ward.name: Recipe: Cinderbug Ward
scroll_cinderbug_ward.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Cinderbug Ward.

rimeshell_ward.name: Rimeshell Ward
rimeshell_ward.desc: As cold as the beetle and as hard to get into. For five minutes no frost can chill you or freeze you.
rimeshell_ward.recipe_from: The College copying room in Fernhollow sells the recipe.

scroll_rimeshell_ward.name: Recipe: Rimeshell Ward
scroll_rimeshell_ward.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Rimeshell Ward.

rimebloom_tonic.name: Rimebloom Tonic
rimebloom_tonic.desc: Blue, and cold enough to ache the teeth. Restores 20 hitpoints and boosts Defence by 6 and a seventh.
rimebloom_tonic.recipe_from: Garrow the smith sells the recipe in Mossvale.

scroll_rimebloom_tonic.name: Recipe: Rimebloom Tonic
scroll_rimebloom_tonic.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Rimebloom Tonic.

glacier_ward.name: Glacier Ward
glacier_ward.desc: It frosts the glass from the inside. For eight minutes no frost can chill you or freeze you, and no water can soak you through.
glacier_ward.recipe_from: The College copying room in Fernhollow sells the recipe.

scroll_glacier_ward.name: Recipe: Glacier Ward
scroll_glacier_ward.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Glacier Ward.

draught_of_fury.name: Draught of Fury
draught_of_fury.desc: Hot going down, and hotter after. Boosts Attack and Strength by 6 and a seventh.
draught_of_fury.recipe_from: The Collector in the Reverie sells the recipe.

scroll_draught_of_fury.name: Recipe: Draught of Fury
scroll_draught_of_fury.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Draught of Fury.

ashen_ward.name: Ashen Ward
ashen_ward.desc: Grey, and it tastes of a hearth gone out. For eight minutes nothing can set you burning or poison you, and burning ground bites half as hard.
ashen_ward.recipe_from: Garrow the smith sells the recipe in Mossvale.

scroll_ashen_ward.name: Recipe: Ashen Ward
scroll_ashen_ward.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Ashen Ward.

hawkeye_draught.name: Hawkeye Draught
hawkeye_draught.desc: As clear as the pool it came out of, and it leaves the eye clearer. Boosts Ranged by 6 and a sixth.
hawkeye_draught.recipe_from: Hunter Ivo sells the recipe in Havenbrook.

scroll_hawkeye_draught.name: Recipe: Hawkeye Draught
scroll_hawkeye_draught.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Hawkeye Draught.

tidemind_draught.name: Tidemind Draught
tidemind_draught.desc: It moves in the vial like a tide coming in. Restores 120 mana and boosts Magic by 6 and a sixth.
tidemind_draught.recipe_from: The College copying room in Fernhollow sells the recipe.

scroll_tidemind_draught.name: Recipe: Tidemind Draught
scroll_tidemind_draught.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Tidemind Draught.

storm_ward.name: Storm Ward
storm_ward.desc: It crackles when the stopper comes out. For eight minutes no lightning can take hold of you, and no blow can knock the sense out of you.
storm_ward.recipe_from: Oona sells the recipe in Mossvale.

scroll_storm_ward.name: Recipe: Storm Ward
scroll_storm_ward.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Storm Ward.

firmament_elixir.name: Firmament Elixir
firmament_elixir.desc: There is weather in it. Restores 60 hitpoints, 150 mana and all stamina, and boosts every combat level by 4 and a tenth.
firmament_elixir.recipe_from: The Collector in the Reverie sells the recipe.

scroll_firmament_elixir.name: Recipe: Firmament Elixir
scroll_firmament_elixir.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Firmament Elixir.

primordium_ward.name: Primordium Ward
primordium_ward.desc: Every element in one bottle, and none of them on speaking terms. For ten minutes nothing takes hold of you -- no fire, frost, water, lightning, poison or bleeding, and no blow that would leave you reeling.
primordium_ward.recipe_from: The College copying room in Fernhollow sells the recipe.

scroll_primordium_ward.name: Recipe: Primordium Ward
scroll_primordium_ward.desc: Brewing notes in a careful hand. Read it to learn to brew Primordium Ward.

scroll_enchant_warding.name: Charm: Warding
scroll_enchant_warding.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of Warding, worked at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_keenness.name: Charm: Keenness
scroll_enchant_keenness.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of Keenness, worked at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_might.name: Charm: Might
scroll_enchant_might.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of Might, worked at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_hawks_eye.name: Charm: Hawk's Eye
scroll_enchant_hawks_eye.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of the Hawk's Eye, worked at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_insight.name: Charm: Insight
scroll_enchant_insight.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of Insight, worked at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_fortitude.name: Charm: Fortitude
scroll_enchant_fortitude.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of Fortitude, worked at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_the_wind.name: Charm: Wind
scroll_enchant_the_wind.desc: A rune drawn out stroke by stroke, and the words to say over it. Read it to learn the enchantment of the Wind, worked at an enchanting table.

tome_magic_missile.name: Tome: Magic Missile
tome_magic_missile.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Magic Missile.

tome_scorching_ray.name: Tome: Scorching Ray
tome_scorching_ray.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Scorching Ray.

tome_hail_of_blades.name: Tome: Hail of Blades
tome_hail_of_blades.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Hail of Blades.

tome_cloud_of_daggers.name: Tome: Cloud of Daggers
tome_cloud_of_daggers.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Cloud of Daggers.

tome_thunderwave.name: Tome: Thunderwave
tome_thunderwave.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Thunderwave.

tome_starfall.name: Tome: Starfall
tome_starfall.desc: A bound volume the college keeps under glass and copies for no one twice, its pages flecked with something that catches the light. Read it to learn Starfall.

spider_silk.name: Spider Silk
spider_silk.desc: A sticky skein from a cellar spider. Weavers pay for it.

lizard_scale.name: Lizard Scale
lizard_scale.desc: A hard green scale off a swamp lizardman.

troll_hide.name: Troll Hide
troll_hide.desc: Thick, pale and cold to the touch. An ice troll's pelt.

wyvern_scale.name: Wyvern Scale
wyvern_scale.desc: A frost wyvern's scale, blue as deep ice and harder than steel.

demon_horn.name: Demon Horn
demon_horn.desc: Black, ridged and still warm. Something in the pit wanted it back.

dragon_fang.name: Dragon Fang
dragon_fang.desc: A tooth from the dragon of the Ice Spire, longer than a dagger and cold to hold.

drowned_king_boots.name: Boots of the Drowned King
drowned_king_boots.desc: Bog-black leather under drowned gold, weed still in the buckles. Whoever was laid in the barrow with these on walked out of the Mire once, and only once.
drowned_king_boots.passive_text: Marshstride: you walk 15% quicker, and ground that burns takes half as much out of you.

rotten_flesh.name: Rotten Flesh
rotten_flesh.desc: Cold, grey and still on the bone in places. Somebody will buy it. Do not ask what for.

tarnished_ring.name: Tarnished Ring
tarnished_ring.desc: Silver gone black, with a dull stone in it. It was buried with somebody who could afford better.

mourning_locket.name: Mourning Locket
mourning_locket.desc: A lock of somebody's hair behind a hinged case. The catch still works.

grave_candle.name: Grave Candle
grave_candle.desc: A stub of funeral wax that has burned longer than it had any business burning.

tinderbox.name: Tinderbox
tinderbox.desc: Flint, steel and a twist of charcloth. Use it with something in your pack that will take a flame.

lantern_unlit.name: Unlit Lantern
lantern_unlit.desc: Iron frame, horn panes, a wick sitting in oil. It wants a flame: use a tinderbox while you carry it.
lantern_unlit.recipe_from: Innkeeper Bess showed you how the old well-crews made theirs.

lantern.name: Lit Lantern
lantern.desc: It throws a good pool of light and asks for nothing but a hand to hold it. Worn in the off hand.

wolf_pelt.name: Wolf Pelt
wolf_pelt.desc: Grey, thick and still burred from the Westwold. A tanner wants it.

fell_wolf_pelt.name: Fell Wolf Pelt
fell_wolf_pelt.desc: Pale as the high grass of the Fells it came off. Hunter Ivo pays for white ones.

bear_hide.name: Bear Hide
bear_hide.desc: It took two hands to drag this out of the Brackenwood.

demon_hide.name: Demon Hide
demon_hide.desc: Red-black and still warm. It does not like being folded.

greatwolf_pelt.name: Greatwolf Pelt
greatwolf_pelt.desc: White as the Frostreach snow it came off, and the size of a blanket.

dire_bear_hide.name: Dire Bear Hide
dire_bear_hide.desc: Grizzled nearly black, a finger thick. The Warlord's Howe keeps the bears that wear it.

dread_hide.name: Dread Hide
dread_hide.desc: The skin of something that was only ever dreamed. It came back with you anyway.

dragonhide.name: Dragonhide
dragonhide.desc: Frost-pale scale on hide like sailcloth. There is not much of this in the world.

flax.name: Flax
flax.desc: Blue-flowered stalks from the Westwold's field edges. Retted and spun, it is linen.

bolt_cloth.name: Bolt of Cloth
bolt_cloth.desc: Plain weave, a yard wide. What every robe starts as.

bag_satchel.name: Hide Satchel
bag_satchel.desc: A satchel of boiled hide on a wide strap, cut to sit under the arm. Put it on and there is another row of room in the bag.

bag_pack.name: Wolfskin Pack
bag_pack.desc: A frame pack in wolf pelt, scaled at the corners where a pack wears through. It rides high and holds more than it looks.

bag_rucksack.name: Bearskin Rucksack
bag_rucksack.desc: Bear hide over troll, sewn with silk because nothing else would go through it twice. It will outlast whoever carries it.

bag_haversack.name: Greatwolf Haversack
bag_haversack.desc: White pelt off the Frostreach, dire bear at the seams, wyvern scale on the flap, and something from a dream stitched into the lining, where there is more room than there is outside.

egg.name: Egg
egg.desc: Still warm. The hens at Havenbrook's farm lay more than the town eats.

milk.name: Pail of Milk
milk.desc: Drawn this morning, and it will not keep past this evening.

honey.name: Honey
honey.desc: Thick and gold and smelling of clover, taken warm from the hives by Farmer Aldous's fields in the Westwold.

wool.name: Fleece
wool.desc: A whole fleece off a Havenbrook ewe, greasy and warm. It spins into good cloth.

raw_chicken.name: Raw Chicken
raw_chicken.desc: A bird off the farm, plucked and drawn.

cooked_chicken.name: Roast Chicken
cooked_chicken.desc: Crisp at the edges. A working lunch.

raw_mutton.name: Raw Mutton
raw_mutton.desc: A cut off a hill ewe, dark and close-grained.

cooked_mutton.name: Roast Mutton
cooked_mutton.desc: Fat, salt and an hour over the coals.

raw_pork.name: Raw Pork
raw_pork.desc: Off one of the farm's pigs, which were nobody's favourites anyway.

cooked_pork.name: Roast Pork
cooked_pork.desc: Crackling, and enough of it to share.

raw_beef.name: Raw Beef
raw_beef.desc: A side off one of the herd. It is more than one person can carry comfortably.

cooked_beef.name: Roast Beef
cooked_beef.desc: Rested, carved and still pink in the middle.

raw_frog_legs.name: Frog Legs
raw_frog_legs.desc: From the mire. People are funny about them until they have had them.

frog_legs.name: Fried Frog Legs
frog_legs.desc: Butter, salt and a squeeze of something sour. Better than they sound.

hearty_stew.name: Hearty Stew
hearty_stew.desc: Beef, milk and a handful of mint, an hour in the pot. It fills a corner that bread does not reach.

fishermans_broth.name: Fisherman's Broth
fishermans_broth.desc: Trout heads, minnows and nettle. Every jetty on the Hollowmarch makes it and every one of them says theirs is right.

hunters_skewers.name: Hunter's Skewers
hunters_skewers.desc: Boar and bird turned over the fire on a green stick. What a hunting party eats standing up.

travellers_pie.name: Traveller's Pie
travellers_pie.desc: Mutton and egg under a lid of pastry, made to be carried a day and eaten cold at the end of it.

moonpetal_tea.name: Moonpetal Tea
moonpetal_tea.desc: Pale and faintly sweet. The college drinks it by the gallon the night before an examination.

honeyed_oats.name: Honeyed Oats
honeyed_oats.desc: Oats and milk, an egg beaten in, and honey from the Westwold hives over the top. The first thing anybody learns to make that is not simply burnt.

roast_supper.name: Farmer's Supper
roast_supper.desc: Pork, beef and sage, and more of all three than is sensible. Havenbrook eats it on the last day of harvest.

salmon_pie.name: Salmon Pie
salmon_pie.desc: Salmon and egg under a crust, with glowcaps chopped through it that still light the plate. A hunter's dinner: it keeps the breath long and the eye steady.

honey_roast_goose.name: Honey-Roast Goose
honey_roast_goose.desc: Two geese glazed with honey and a pinch of emberbloom for the heat, roasted until the skin cracks. It sits heavy, and the arm behind a blow is the better for it.

fried_frog_legs.name: Frog Legs in Butter
fried_frog_legs.desc: Quick, light and gone in a minute. Mire fare, and better than the mire's reputation.

frostfin_chowder.name: Frostfin Chowder
frostfin_chowder.desc: Frostfin, milk and a little mint, simmered slow. The trapper on the Glass Mere lives on it, and looks it.

cindergill_skewers.name: Cindergill Skewers
cindergill_skewers.desc: Cindergill and emberbloom on iron skewers, charred at the edges. It goes down warm and stays warm, somewhere behind the ribs.

deepgleam_broth.name: Deepgleam Broth
deepgleam_broth.desc: A clear broth with moonpetal floating in it, and a light at the bottom of the bowl that is the fish. The College's kitchen makes it the night before examinations.

hollowmarch_feast.name: Hollowmarch Feast
hollowmarch_feast.desc: Every fish the far north and the Primordium have to give, on one board, with beef under all of it. It takes an evening to eat, and leaves you fit for whatever the night brings.

raw_duck.name: Raw Duck
raw_duck.desc: A wild bird off the pond at Fernhollow, plucked and drawn.

cooked_duck.name: Roast Duck
cooked_duck.desc: Dark meat and crackling skin. Worth the plucking.

raw_goose.name: Raw Goose
raw_goose.desc: Heavy in the hand. There is a dinner in one of these.

cooked_goose.name: Roast Goose
cooked_goose.desc: The whole bird, and enough of it to share.

totem_broodmother.name: Totem of the Broodmother
totem_broodmother.desc: Dark wood, eight legs, and eyes that catch the light. She was killed fifteen times before she gave this up. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Skittering.

totem_lizardman_chief.name: Totem of the Lizardman Chief
totem_lizardman_chief.desc: A crested head cut in green stone, gold at the brow. The Mire's chiefs are buried with theirs. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Cold Blood.

totem_barrow_wight.name: Totem of the Hollowrest Wight
totem_barrow_wight.desc: A skull on a grey post. Colder than the room it is in. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Grave Chill.

totem_orc3.name: Totem of the Warchief
totem_orc3.desc: Red paint, a horned helm. It smells of smoke and the lower workings. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Warchief's Fury.

totem_well_warden.name: Totem of the Thing in the Spring
totem_well_warden.desc: A lantern on a post of wet stone. The light in it is the colour of deep water. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Deep Water.

totem_den_mother.name: Totem of the Den Mother
totem_den_mother.desc: A bear's head in old brown wood, worn smooth where a hand would rest. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Thick Hide.

totem_nightmare_troll.name: Totem of the Sleepless
totem_nightmare_troll.desc: Heavy-browed and tusked, the colour of a bad night. It was not there when you woke; then it was. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Troll's Blood.

totem_wyvern_matriarch.name: Totem of the Wyvern Matriarch
totem_wyvern_matriarch.desc: Pale wings on a pale post. It hums in a wind. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Wind Under Wing.

totem_pit_lord.name: Totem of the Pit Lord
totem_pit_lord.desc: Black, horned, with an ember in its head that has not gone out. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Hellfire.

totem_frost_dragon.name: Totem of Hoarfang
totem_frost_dragon.desc: Ice that does not melt, cut into a crest of spines. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Hoarfrost.

totem_nightmare_dragon.name: Totem of the Unwaking
totem_nightmare_dragon.desc: A spined head the violet of the deep Reverie. Looking at it for long is a mistake. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Dread.

tome_acid_spray.name: Tome: Acid Spray
tome_acid_spray.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Acid Spray.

tome_ice_touch.name: Tome: Ice Touch
tome_ice_touch.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Ice Touch.

tome_vampiric_touch.name: Tome: Vampiric Touch
tome_vampiric_touch.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Vampiric Touch.

tome_hellish_rebuke.name: Tome: Hellish Rebuke
tome_hellish_rebuke.desc: A bound volume from the college's copying room, the words worn where a hundred students have run a finger under them. Read it to learn Hellish Rebuke.

ashcroft_signet.name: Ashcroft's Signet
ashcroft_signet.desc: Heavy red gold, the crest worn smooth by a thumb that kept turning it. It is warm when you pick it up and it does not stop being warm. What it takes out of whatever you hit, it gives to you.

totem_vampire_lord.name: Totem of Lord Ashcroft
totem_vampire_lord.desc: A signet ring of red gold hammered flat and nailed to a black stake. He was put down fifteen times in the Black Vault before he left this behind. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: The Red Thirst.

totem_bayou_matriarch.name: Totem of the Fen
totem_bayou_matriarch.desc: Reed, tooth and river clay, bound with her own shed hide. It is still damp, and it stays damp. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Fenborn.

heart_of_cinders.name: Heart of Cinders
heart_of_cinders.desc: A coal on a chain of black gold, taken from the Cinder King's chest. It has not gone out and you do not think it will. It beats, a little slower than yours. Whoever wears it hits harder, and is harder to put down.

totem_cinder_king.name: Totem of the Cinder King
totem_cinder_king.desc: A black stake with his horns on it, and between them a ring of gold that has not cooled. He fell fifteen times at the foot of his own throne before he left this behind. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Crown of Cinders.

reed_doll.name: Reed Doll
reed_doll.desc: A doll of plaited reeds bound with red thread, thorns pushed through its middle. The lizardfolk hang these where their matriarch has walked.
reed_doll.found: The reed doll's thorns prick your palm, and out in the Bayou something hisses back. Picking it up has started something.

drowned_locket.name: Drowned Locket
drowned_locket.desc: A tin locket green with the Bayou, its hinge rusted shut. Something small rattles inside.
drowned_locket.found: Something in the locket knocks twice, like a knuckle on a door. Picking it up has started something.

bell_clapper.name: Bell Clapper
bell_clapper.desc: The iron tongue of a bell, as long as your forearm and as cold as a grave. Somebody wrenched it out and dropped it in the graveyard grass.
bell_clapper.found: The clapper is colder than it has any right to be, and from under the ground, very faintly, a bell tries to ring. Picking it up has started something.

ashcroft_letter.name: Ashcroft's Letter
ashcroft_letter.desc: A letter sealed in black wax with a bat, addressed in a thin old hand to the Guild of Havenbrook. The seal has never been broken.
ashcroft_letter.found: The black wax is warm under your thumb, as though it had just been sealed. Picking it up has started something.

cinder_invitation.name: Cinder Invitation
cinder_invitation.desc: A card of heavy paper edged in gold, the writing burned into it rather than inked. It requests the pleasure of your company.
cinder_invitation.found: The card is warm, and as you read it your name scorches itself into the space left for a guest. Picking it up has started something.

rime_key.name: Rime Key
rime_key.desc: A key of blue ice that does not melt, even here. Scratched into its bow, very small: SPIREWATCH.
rime_key.found: The key burns cold through your glove, and at the far end of the dungeon something frozen starts to move. Picking it up has started something.

bloodied_collar.name: Bloodied Collar
bloodied_collar.desc: A dog's leather collar with a brass tag, chewed through and dark with old blood. The tag says JUNIPER.
bloodied_collar.found: The brass tag says JUNIPER, and somewhere across the Westwold a wolf howls and another answers. Picking it up has started something.

antler_circlet.name: Antler Circlet
antler_circlet.desc: Two antler tines bound into a ring with green wire, the kind a child wears to the midsummer fair. There are tooth marks on one side.
antler_circlet.found: There is a trapper's mark cut into the wire, and not far off a wolf is watching you. Picking it up has started something.

totem_cerberus.name: Totem of Cerberus
totem_cerberus.desc: A black stake hung with three iron collars, their spikes still hot. It walked round the Stronghold fifteen times with you at its heels before it left this behind. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Collar of Cerberus.

totem_hex_priest.name: Totem of the High Priest
totem_hex_priest.desc: A stake of black cypress with a poppet of sacking bound to it, its heart stuck through with a pin for every time you came through his sanctum and left him on its floor. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: The Priest's Poppet.

totem_abominable.name: Totem of the Abominable Snowman
totem_abominable.desc: A post of blue ice that does not melt, a tuft of long white fur frozen into the top of it. Fifteen times you found the thing in the snow and fifteen times you walked away. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: Pelt of the Abominable.

scroll_enchant_affliction.name: Charm: Affliction
scroll_enchant_affliction.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Affliction, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_precision.name: Charm: Precision
scroll_enchant_precision.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Precision, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_sorcery.name: Charm: Sorcery
scroll_enchant_sorcery.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Sorcery, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_quickdraw.name: Charm: Quickdraw
scroll_enchant_quickdraw.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Quickdraw, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_multishot.name: Charm: Multishot
scroll_enchant_multishot.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Multishot, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_vampiric.name: Charm: Vampiric
scroll_enchant_vampiric.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Vampiric, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_ferocity.name: Charm: Ferocity
scroll_enchant_ferocity.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Ferocity, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_brand_bleeding.name: Charm: Brand of Bleeding
scroll_enchant_brand_bleeding.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn the Brand of Bleeding, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_brand_venom.name: Charm: Brand of Venom
scroll_enchant_brand_venom.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn the Brand of Venom, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_brand_frost.name: Charm: Brand of Frost
scroll_enchant_brand_frost.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn the Brand of Frost, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_brand_embers.name: Charm: Brand of Embers
scroll_enchant_brand_embers.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn the Brand of Embers, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

scroll_enchant_thrift.name: Charm: Thrift
scroll_enchant_thrift.desc: A rune for a weapon, and the words to say over it at every strength the hand can manage. Read it to learn Thrift, worked into a weapon at an enchanting table.

poppet_idol.name: Poppet Idol (0/5)
poppet_idol.desc: The reed doll, bound again by Oona in new red thread: five turns, five knots, all of them loose. Laid on a witch's table in the Bayou it calls the fen to it. It can be fed once a day.

poppet_idol_1.name: Poppet Idol (1/5)
poppet_idol_1.desc: Oona's poppet, fed at a witch's table. One of its five knots is pulled tight. It can be fed once a day, at a witch's table in the Bayou.

poppet_idol_2.name: Poppet Idol (2/5)
poppet_idol_2.desc: Oona's poppet, fed at a witch's table. Two of its five knots are pulled tight. It can be fed once a day, at a witch's table in the Bayou.

poppet_idol_3.name: Poppet Idol (3/5)
poppet_idol_3.desc: Oona's poppet, fed at a witch's table. Three of its five knots are pulled tight. It can be fed once a day, at a witch's table in the Bayou.

poppet_idol_4.name: Poppet Idol (4/5)
poppet_idol_4.desc: Oona's poppet, fed at a witch's table. Four of its five knots are pulled tight. It is heavy now, heavier than reeds should be. It can be fed once a day, at a witch's table in the Bayou.

poppet_idol_5.name: Poppet Idol (5/5)
poppet_idol_5.desc: All five knots are pulled tight and the doll is as heavy as a stone. It wants nothing more of the fen. Oona, in Mossvale, will want to see it.

hexpin.name: The Hexpin
hexpin.desc: A long black blade no wider than a poppet's pin, red thread wound up the grip. One cut in three is left bleeding.

thornwife_bow.name: Thornwife's Bow
thornwife_bow.desc: Black thorn from the fen, strung with the Mother's own red thread. One arrow in three goes in with the thorn's venom.

poppet_staff.name: The Poppet Staff
poppet_staff.desc: Crowned with a little poppet of its own, all five of its knots tight. Every spell costs a fifth less, and what it throws turns after its mark.

ember_core.name: Ember Core
ember_core.desc: The heart an Ember Conjure burned round. Still warm, and it will be for as long as anyone keeps it.

stone_heart.name: Stone Heart
stone_heart.desc: What held a Stone Conjure together: a fist of stone veined with amber light, heavier than it looks.

tide_pearl.name: Tide Pearl
tide_pearl.desc: A pearl the size of a plum, left where a Tide Conjure poured away. There is a sea moving inside it.

gale_plume.name: Gale Plume
gale_plume.desc: A feather of solid air from the eye of a Gale Conjure. It weighs nothing and will not lie still.

storm_glass.name: Storm Glass
storm_glass.desc: Glass a Storm Conjure fused out of nothing as it died. It crackles in the hand, and your hair stands up.

conflux_heart.name: Heart of the Conflux
conflux_heart.desc: A prism the size of a heart, taken from where the Quintessence fell. All five are in it, turning: a flame, a stone, a wave, a wind, a spark. Whoever wears it fights with every one of them.

totem_quintessence.name: Totem of the Quintessence
totem_quintessence.desc: A black stake with five stones set in it, one of each: a coal, an amber, a pearl, a feather of air and a bead of storm glass. The Quintessence came apart fifteen times in the Conflux before it left this behind. Stood in the ring in your house at Mossvale and touched, it gives its blessing until dawn: The Fifth Essence.

hearty_meal.name: Hearty Meal
hearty_meal.desc: Bess's bread, a wedge of cheese and a crock of her stew, wrapped to carry. Restores 10 hitpoints.

vigil_dreamcatcher.name: Dreamcatcher
vigil_dreamcatcher.desc: A worn hoop of thread and feathers. It hums faintly, as if listening.

scorched_scale.name: Scorched Scale
scorched_scale.desc: Dark as char and hard as slate, its edges still warm. The Ashen Vanguard left it on the stones when it fell. Whatever it came from was large.

token_candle.name: Brass Token: Candle
token_candle.desc: A round brass token stamped with a candle. It was under the candlestick in the room you woke in.

token_loaf.name: Brass Token: Loaf
token_loaf.desc: A round brass token stamped with a loaf. It fell out of a stale loaf in the inn's kitchen.

token_mug.name: Brass Token: Mug
token_mug.desc: A round brass token stamped with a mug. It was at the bottom of a half-full mug on the bar.

havenbrook_house_key.name: Havenbrook House Key
havenbrook_house_key.desc: Mayor Hale's key to a house on Havenbrook's south street, with a good bed in it. It's yours, free, for as long as you want it.

clothier_shears.name: Dressmaker's Shears
clothier_shears.desc: Wynn's long shears, from behind her desk. They cut anything that is thread -- and in a dream, perhaps more than that.

thread_crimson.name: Crimson Thread
thread_crimson.desc: A cut length of crimson thread from Wynn's wall, the red of the portrait's bodice.

thread_ivory.name: Ivory Thread
thread_ivory.desc: A cut length of ivory thread from Wynn's wall, the pale of the portrait's skirt.

thread_gold.name: Gold Thread
thread_gold.desc: A cut length of gold thread from Wynn's wall, the colour of the portrait's sash.

thread_cobalt.name: Cobalt Thread
thread_cobalt.desc: A cut length of cobalt thread from Wynn's wall. Nothing in the portrait is this blue.

thread_moss.name: Moss Thread
thread_moss.desc: A cut length of moss-green thread from Wynn's wall. Nothing in the portrait is this green.

thread_violet.name: Violet Thread
thread_violet.desc: A cut length of violet thread from Wynn's wall. Nothing in the portrait is this colour.

guild_amulet.name: Guild Amulet
guild_amulet.desc: Silver on a fine chain, the Havenbrook Guild's lantern worked into its face. Made for the Guild's finest; Orlend would not take no for an answer.

guild_ring.name: Guild Ring
guild_ring.desc: A heavy band of blackened silver with the Guild's lantern cut into the bezel. Made for the Guild's finest; Orlend would not take no for an answer.

guild_hood.name: Guild Hood
guild_hood.desc: Deep green wool lined with oiled leather, the Guild's lantern stitched over the brow. Made for the Guild's finest; Orlend would not take no for an answer.

bess_supper.name: Bess's Supper
bess_supper.desc: A proper hot meal from Bess's bar, with your name on it -- not wrapped scraps. Restores 22 hitpoints.

torn_page_graveyard.name: A Torn Page, Grave-Dirty
torn_page_graveyard.desc: A page torn from Apocolo's book, smeared with grave dirt. Half of a recipe in a small, careful hand.

torn_page_lizard.name: A Torn Page, Scaled
torn_page_lizard.desc: A page torn from Apocolo's book, a green scale still caught in its fold.

torn_page_bear.name: A Torn Page, Furred
torn_page_bear.desc: A page torn from Apocolo's book, a tuft of coarse brown fur stuck to it.

torn_page_orc.name: A Torn Page, Greasy
torn_page_orc.desc: A page torn from Apocolo's book, a greasy grey handprint across it.

apocolo_recipe.name: Apocolo's Recipe
apocolo_recipe.desc: Apocolo's book, whole again at the page that matters: the cure for the sleepers, and for the bayou hex they carry. It wants brewing at the cauldron he kept in Havenbrook.

sleepers_cure.name: Apocolo's Cure
sleepers_cure.desc: A vial of pale gold, brewed from Apocolo's recipe. A few drops between a sleeper's lips wakes them -- one dose a sleeper. More can be brewed at his cauldron in Havenbrook.

death_talisman.name: The Death Talisman
death_talisman.desc: Warm to the touch, and it hums. Worn in its own place, it opens the veil for whoever wears it: into the Reverie and out again, without a bed.
death_talisman.passive_text: Worn, its key (T; RB + LB on a pad) steps into the Reverie where you stand, where the place is dreamt, and back out again. Five seconds between.

rune_rubbing.name: A Rubbing of the Rune
rune_rubbing.desc: Taken from the rune behind the Pit Lord's throne, which opened a doorway into the Reverie. Someone at the Magic college has to hear of this.

hoarfang_head.name: Hoarfang's Head
hoarfang_head.desc: The great head of the dragon whose shadow crossed Havenbrook. Elder Vask asked for it.

hoarfang_fang.name: Hoarfang's Fang
hoarfang_fang.desc: One of a pair of daggers cut from Hoarfang's fangs, as cold as the peak it came down from. Light enough for its twin in the other hand.

hoarfang_bow.name: Hoarfang Scale Bow
hoarfang_bow.desc: A bow laid up from Hoarfang's scales, white at the edges.

hoarfang_staff.name: Staff of Hoarfang
hoarfang_staff.desc: A staff of black wood capped with a shard of Hoarfang's horn.

hoarfang_talon.name: Hoarfang's Talon
hoarfang_talon.desc: A greatsword worked from one of Hoarfang's talons. What it cuts is left bleeding.

hoarfang_maul.name: Hoarfang Maul
hoarfang_maul.desc: A maul with a head of Hoarfang's frozen bone. One blow in five rings a head.
